results.criterion: Successful finish leaves its receipt valid and every registered or bound STATUS projection current.
results.observation: Real CLI work start + work finish in the existing WorkRecordTest fixture (independent subprocess): finish exit 0, check_terminal_receipt successful, status_drift(load_project) false, completed story row renders 'done' with no receipt-pending suffix while unrelated unreceipted records keep theirs. Same scenario before the fix returned status_drift true.

results.criterion: Retrying after interrupted STATUS publication repairs the projections without rewriting the receipt or duplicating the completion log.
results.observation: Fault-injected STATUS atomic-write failure leaves record done with a valid receipt; retry repairs both the bound status_root report and a registered-directory report; receipt bytes and completion-log bytes unchanged with exactly one log line. Covered by tests/test_kosmic_work_records.py regression test_interrupted_status_publication_recovers_without_receipt_rewrite (red before the fix with COMPLETION_PENDING on missing receipt, green after).

results.criterion: Missing or stale proof still blocks completion; unrelated pending historical records remain pending.
results.observation: Regression test_valid_receipt_retry_still_denies_corrupted_proof: tampering an acceptance artifact after a successful finish makes the retry fast path raise ACCEPTANCE_INVALID. No historical pending receipt was backfilled; the wave-2 closure record remains receipt-pending in STATUS by design.

results.criterion: Workflow and generated guidance use supported work-record flags and accurately describe recoverable, non-atomic publication.
results.observation: record_first_contract line 1365 now emits `work show ... --work-record RECORD_REF`; task_quick_task.md:93, work_completion.md, README, task_implement_story.md:424 and the finish subcommand help distinguish receipt authority from derived reports and drop cross-file atomicity claims; mutating command examples in task_project_skills.md and docs/installation.md carry --work-record. Round-2 fresh-context review approved both round-1 findings as fixed.
